title: Names used by github_user, github_user_search (P111) and telegram_public (P112)

attributes.account_id: numeric id of the account on its platform (e.g. the GitHub user id)
attributes.account_type: kind of account on its platform (GitHub 'User' | 'Organization'; Telegram 'channel' | 'group' | 'user' | 'bot')
attributes.company: self-declared company / organisation text of a public profile
attributes.website: website URL declared on a public profile
attributes.public_repos: number of public repositories of the account
attributes.public_gists: number of public gists of the account
attributes.following: number of accounts the account follows
attributes.ssh_keys: public SSH keys published on the account: list of {type, fingerprint (OpenSSH SHA256), bits}; key blobs and comments are never kept
attributes.gpg_keys: OpenPGP keys published on the account: list of {fingerprint, key_id, sha256_id, algorithm, bits, curve, created, subkeys, uids}
attributes.commit_emails: e-mail addresses of the seed account's own public commits grouped per address: list of {email, commits, first, last, repos, sources} (case-bound, never sent to breach modules automatically)
attributes.noreply_accounts: GitHub accounts decoded from users.noreply.github.com addresses: list of {handle, id}
attributes.public_activity: summary of the public events read: {events, types, first, last, contributions_window, window_days}
attributes.activity_level: Ceos activity class from public REST events: inactive | low | active | very_active (attribute only, never a sensitive inference)
attributes.stalled_for_months: bool: no public activity for more than 180 days
attributes.estimated_contributions_year: contributions per year estimated from the public events window
attributes.last_activity: ISO date of the latest public activity seen
attributes.name_search: platform name search summary: {query, total_count, incomplete, candidates [{handle, id, type, url, score}]} (POSSIBLE candidates, never expanded)
attributes.subscribers: subscriber count of a public channel
attributes.members: member count of a public group
attributes.online_members: group members online when the page was read
attributes.verified: bool: the platform shows a verified badge on the account
attributes.has_preview: bool: the Telegram channel has a public web preview (t.me/s)
attributes.posts_read: number of public posts read from a web preview
attributes.ioc_summary: one-block summary of the infrastructure indicators in public posts: {summary, counts, top} (top 5 per group, defanged)
attributes.mentioned_handles: Telegram handles linked from post text (listed, never pivoted)
attributes.bot_webhook_exposures: bot tokens and webhook URLs posted publicly: list of {kind, sha256_prefix, posts} (never in clear, never used)
attributes.post_scrubbing: ingestion scrubbing applied to post text before cache, evidence and reports: {pans_truncated, cpfs_redacted, emails_redacted, phones_redacted, records_dropped, drop_reasons}
attributes.brand_mentions: organisation-profile brand terms found in public posts: list of {term, posts}

relations.gpg_uid_email: account -> e-mail in a UID of an OpenPGP key published on the account
relations.noreply_account: account/e-mail -> GitHub account decoded from a users.noreply.github.com address
relations.declared_org: account -> organisation handle declared in its profile (self-declared, unverified)
relations.pgp_key: account -> fingerprint of an OpenPGP key published on the account
relations.name_search_candidate: person name -> account returned by a platform name search (POSSIBLE, never auto-expanded)
relations.mentioned_in_post: public channel -> indicator mentioned in one of its posts (hostile-shaped: never visited automatically)
relations.forwarded_from: public channel -> channel whose posts it forwards
